topic: Instant Grep — Sparse N-gram Regex Index Integration
objective: Integrate a Cursor-style sparse n-gram regex index into Puppet Master as an MVP feature. The index transparently accelerates the existing grep tool for both agent/subagent use and user-facing find-in-files regex search. Same index, dual consumer. Index always local, even for remote projects. Correctness guaranteed by ripgrep verification; index only narrows candidates.

decisions.summary: Go decision: integrate sparse n-gram indexed grep as MVP feature — not post-launch optimization.
decisions.rationale: Agent grep on large repos takes 15+ seconds with raw ripgrep. Sparse n-gram indexing reduces this to 5-20ms. Proven in production at Cursor, ClickHouse, and GitHub Code Search.

decisions.summary: Direction A: transparent acceleration of existing grep tool. Same tool interface, index used when available, fallback to raw ripgrep when not.
decisions.rationale: No changes to agent/subagent tool calls. No new tools. codesearch remains separate (Tantivy/LSP/keyword domain).

decisions.summary: Dual-use: same sparse n-gram index serves both agent grep and user-facing find-in-files regex search.
decisions.rationale: Single index, single build pipeline, single freshness model. Search panel regex toggle uses the same acceleration path.

decisions.summary: Index always local, even for remote projects. This is acceleration (like a CDN), not local fallback.
decisions.rationale: Reconciles with GitHub_Integration.md no-silent-local-fallback rule. Correctness is always verified against actual files.

decisions.summary: Frequency table: hybrid — ship pre-computed base table (The Stack Smol, 256x256 u16 matrix, ~128 KB) + blend with per-project frequencies (alpha=0.5). Stored per-project.
decisions.rationale: Balances general code corpus with project-specific naming conventions and DSLs. Table is stable across incremental updates.

decisions.summary: Remote Git: full bare clone to local cache. Two independent toggles (shallow clone, partial clone), both OFF by default. Global default + per-project override.
decisions.rationale: Full bare clone gives best index quality and offline grep. Toggles allow reducing footprint when disk is constrained.

decisions.summary: Non-Git remote: Option 2 — remote-build index, transfer to local, query locally, verify candidates remotely via SSH.
decisions.rationale: No Git for diffing/bare-clone. Remote indexer binary scp'd per architecture. Acceptable SSH cost for rare case.

decisions.summary: Atomic index publishing via ArcSwap + generation-numbered directories. No multi-file rename atomicity issues.
decisions.rationale: Readers hold Arc to old snapshot, builder publishes new snapshot via atomic pointer swap. Windows-safe, lock-free reads.

decisions.summary: PM-mediated writes update dirty layer synchronously — not via file watcher. File watcher is backup for external changes only.
decisions.rationale: This is the freshness guarantee: agent write -> grep for content -> MUST find it. Synchronous insert before returning success.

decisions.summary: No stale threshold. Index always used when present. Dirty layer guarantees correctness regardless of staleness.
decisions.rationale: A stale index produces more candidates (less efficient), never incorrect results. Background updates keep it fresh.

decisions.summary: Index normalization pipeline: strip CRLF (0x0D) then ASCII-only lowercase (u8::to_ascii_lowercase). Both build and query time.
decisions.rationale: Makes index line-ending-agnostic (bare clone LF vs Windows CRLF). Case-insensitive queries work without case-variant explosion.

decisions.summary: Regex alternation uses union-of-intersections, not pure intersection. foo|bar = intersect within each alt, union across alts.
decisions.rationale: Pure intersection would cause false negatives. foo|bar must return files with foo OR bar.

decisions.summary: Ripgrep cannot search bare clones (no working tree). Verification uses git show {sha}:{path} piped to ripgrep stdin.
decisions.rationale: Bare clones are object stores, not filesystems. git show extracts file content at a specific commit for piped verification.

decisions.summary: Rust crate set: regex-syntax, roaring, memmap2, xxhash-rust, arc-swap, thread-priority. trigrep and fast-grep-rust are study references only.
decisions.rationale: Assembling well-understood proven crates, not building a novel algorithm from scratch.

decisions.summary: Project settings: dedicated Indexing section. Contains enable toggle, large file threshold (10 MB), index exclusion patterns, symlinks toggle, rebuild button, disk usage, cache eviction (remote only).
decisions.rationale: Indexing concerns are separate from search settings and general settings. Dedicated section prevents drift.

anchors.anchor: #### 3.5.A Additional semantics: chatsearch / logs / repo import and codesearch multi-tier (MVP)
anchors.content_markdown:
This subsection supplements the per-tool table below with required behavior for new MVP tools and multi-tier search backends.

**chatsearch (project chat index)**
- **Input:** `query: string`, optional `filters: { thread_id?, time_range? }`, `k?: number`.
- **Output:** hits with `{ thread_id, message_id, ts, role, snippet, score }`.
- **Scope rule:** MUST be project-scoped (per-project Tantivy index directory).
- **Secrets policy:** Persisted chat index content MUST comply with PolicyRule:no_secrets_in_storage / INV-002 (mandatory strict secrets scrubbing before persistence).
- **Context Lens integration:** When Context Lens mutes messages, chatsearch MUST exclude muted message_ids from results returned to the agent (or annotate them as excluded so the context packer can drop them).

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md, ContractName:Plans/assistant-chat-design.md, ContractName:Plans/Permissions_System.md

**codesearch (project workspace code search; MVP multi-tier)**
- **Primary backend:** Tantivy code index (filesystem watcher + chunked documents; see Plans/storage-plan.md).
- **Secondary backend:** LSP `workspace/symbol` and/or `documentSymbol` for symbol-aware search when LSP is active (Plans/LSPSupport.md).
- **Fallback backend:** text grep (`grep` tool, index-accelerated when sparse n-gram index is available) when Tantivy index is unavailable or query requires regex semantics.
- **Output:** Return best-effort results with stable `{ path, line_or_range, snippet, kind? }`.
- **Ignore + sensitive guards:** Respect `.gitignore` by default; exclude `.env` and `.env.*` (allow `.env.example`) consistent with FileSafe + Permissions defaults.
- **Secrets policy:** Any indexed/stored snippet text MUST be secrets-scrubbed before persistence to Tantivy.

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md, ContractName:Plans/LSPSupport.md, ContractName:Plans/FileSafe.md

**grep (index-accelerated regex search; MVP)**

The `grep` tool is transparently accelerated by a per-project sparse n-gram regex index when available.

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md, Invariant:INV-002

- **Index architecture:** Per-project sparse n-gram index built locally. Variable-length n-grams extracted using frequency-weighted boundary detection. Index narrows candidate files; ripgrep verifies final results for correctness.
- **Query flow:** Parse regex via `regex-syntax` → extract literals → normalize (strip CRLF, ASCII-lowercase) → compute covering n-gram set → hash (xxh3 64-bit) → binary search mmap'd lookup table → intersect/union posting lists (Roaring Bitmaps) → candidate file IDs → resolve to paths → filter by path/glob → add dirty-layer paths → ripgrep verification on candidates only.
- **Conjunction vs disjunction:** Conjunction (all literals required): intersect posting lists. Disjunction (alternation, e.g. `foo|bar`): union-of-intersections — intersect within each alternative, then union across alternatives.
- **Non-literal patterns:** When `regex-syntax::literal` extracts no literals (e.g. `.*`, `[a-z]+`, `\\d{3}`), skip index → full ripgrep scan. Natural fallback.
- **Case handling:** Index built on ASCII-lowercased bytes. Both case-sensitive and case-insensitive queries work. Case-insensitive queries with non-ASCII literals skip the index → ripgrep fallback (ASCII-only lowercasing cannot normalize non-ASCII case variants).
- **Complexity cap:** Skip index when covering set exceeds 64 n-grams (internal constant, not configurable).
- **Freshness guarantee:** PM-mediated writes (agent/tool) update the dirty layer synchronously before returning success. Dirty-layer files are always included in the candidate set. Agents reading their own writes MUST find them.
- **Fallback:** When index is missing, building, corrupted, or disabled, grep falls back to raw ripgrep on all files. Transparent to callers — no error surfaced.
- **Secrets scrubber:** All file content passes through the mandatory secrets scrubber before n-gram extraction. Same policy as Tantivy (PolicyRule:no_secrets_in_storage / INV-002).
- **User-facing search:** When the Search panel regex toggle is ON, the same sparse n-gram index accelerates find-in-files. Same flow, same freshness guarantees.

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/FinalGUISpec.md, ContractName:Plans/GitHub_Integration.md, ContractName:Plans/Architecture_Invariants.md

**logsearch / logread (project logs)**
- **logsearch input:** `query: string`, optional `filters: { time_range?, run_id?, thread_id?, tool_name?, level? }`, `k?: number`.
- **logsearch output:** hits with `{ ts, summary, run_id?, thread_id?, tool_name?, level?, ref: { event_id? | blob_ref? } }`.
- **logread input:** `{ event_id? | blob_ref? }`.
- **logread output:** `{ content, truncated?: boolean, truncation_reason? }` (bounded by size caps).
- **Index rule:** Tantivy logs index stores summaries/snippets only; full payload remains out-of-index and is fetched via logread.
- **Secrets policy:** Log summaries/snippets and any persisted payload returned by logread MUST comply with PolicyRule:no_secrets_in_storage / INV-002 (mandatory strict secrets scrubbing before persistence).
- **Blob resolution:** `blob_ref` resolves to `storage/blobs/projects/{project_id}/logs/...` (see Plans/storage-plan.md).

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md, ContractName:Plans/Contracts_V0.md

**repo.import (external repo import; separate from workspace search)**
- **Input:** `{ source: string (URL or owner/repo), dest_path?, mode?: "new_project"|"add_workspace_root"|"temporary_mount" }`.

Tool invocation events:

The `tool.invoked` event for `grep` MUST include an optional `index_used: boolean` field indicating whether the sparse n-gram index was used to accelerate the query. When `true`, the index narrowed the candidate file set before ripgrep verification. When `false` or absent, raw ripgrep was used on all files (fallback path).

All storage lives under a single **app data root** (e.g. `~/.puppet-master/` or `$XDG_DATA_HOME/puppet-master/` on Linux; `%APPDATA%/puppet-master` on Windows; `~/Library/Application Support/puppet-master` on macOS). Project-specific data (e.g. per-project seglog or redb) may live under **project root / project workspace** (e.g. `.puppet-master/`) when we want isolation per workspace; the plan below assumes **app-global** seglog/redb by default, with **project_id** or **project_path** in keys where needed.

| Path (relative to app data root) | Purpose |
|----------------------------------|---------||
| `storage/seglog/` | seglog segment files (or single `events.log`). Append-only. |
| `storage/redb/` | redb database file(s). One main DB (e.g. `state.redb`) for settings, sessions, checkpoints, rollups; schema versioned via migrations. |
| `storage/jsonl/` | Human-readable JSONL mirror of seglog (one file per day or one rolling file). Written by projector. |
| `storage/tantivy/projects/{project_id}/` | **Per-project** Tantivy index directories (e.g. `chat`, `code`, `logs`, optional `docs`). Built by projectors/watchers. Per-project indices are required for project-only search scoping and for long-lived performance (see §2.4 and Plans/assistant-chat-design.md §10.3). |
| `storage/blobs/` | Blob store for large persisted payloads referenced by `blob_ref` (e.g. secrets-scrubbed tool/log payloads used by `logread`). |
| `storage/backups/` | Optional: point-in-time copies of redb or seglog for recovery. |

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/FinalGUISpec.md, ContractName:Plans/GitHub_Integration.md

**Per-project regex index storage (local projects):**

| Path (relative to project root) | Purpose |
|----------------------------------|---------||
| `.puppet-master/project/state/regex_index/` | Root directory for sparse n-gram regex index files |
| `.puppet-master/project/state/regex_index/frequency_table.bin` | Project-specific blended frequency table (~128 KB, 256×256 u16 matrix) |
| `.puppet-master/project/state/regex_index/gen-{N}/` | Generation-numbered directory (N = monotonic u64). Contains all binary index files for one atomic snapshot |
| `.puppet-master/project/state/regex_index/gen-{N}/postings.bin` | Posting lists — Roaring Bitmaps of u32 file IDs, flushed sequentially per n-gram hash |
| `.puppet-master/project/state/regex_index/gen-{N}/lookup.bin` | Sorted xxh3-hash→offset table (memory-mapped). Binary search to find posting list offset in postings.bin |
| `.puppet-master/project/state/regex_index/gen-{N}/file_map.bin` | Sequential u32 file_id → relative file path mapping (forward-slash normalized) |
| `.puppet-master/project/state/regex_index/gen-{N}/index_meta.json` | Anchor SHA, timestamps, schema version, file count, per-file xxh3 checksums, generation number, `case_sensitive_fs`, `roaring_format` |

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/Tools.md, Invariant:INV-002, ContractName:Plans/Architecture_Invariants.md

**Per-project regex index storage (remote projects):**

| Path (relative to app data root) | Purpose |
|----------------------------------|---------||
| `.puppet-master/cache/r/{hash8}/` | Remote project cache root. `hash8` = first 8 chars of xxh3(project_id) to avoid MAX_PATH issues |
| `.puppet-master/cache/r/{hash8}/git/` | Bare Git clone (full, shallow, or partial per settings). Git-based remote projects only |
| `.puppet-master/cache/r/{hash8}/git/m/{sub_hash8}/` | Bare Git clones of submodule repos (hash8 of submodule_path). Recursive, max depth 5 |
| `.puppet-master/cache/r/{hash8}/dirty/` | Local staging area for dirty file content from remote change notifications. Cleared on re-anchor |
| `.puppet-master/cache/r/{hash8}/regex_index/` | Same structure as local projects: frequency_table.bin + gen-{N}/ with postings.bin, lookup.bin, file_map.bin, index_meta.json |
| `.puppet-master/cache/r/{hash8}/manifest.json` | Maps hash8 → full project_id/submodule_path for recovery |

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/GitHub_Integration.md, ContractName:Plans/BinaryLocator_Spec.md

Binary file formats (all little-endian, no padding between fields):
- **file_map.bin:** Magic `PMFM` (4 bytes) + schema_version (u32) + entry_count (u32) = 12 bytes header. Entries: path_byte_length (u32) + UTF-8 path bytes. File ID N = Nth entry. All paths forward-slash normalized
- **lookup.bin:** Magic `PMLK` (4 bytes) + schema_version (u32) + entry_count (u32) = 12 bytes header. Entries: sorted (xxh3_hash: u64, postings_offset: u64) = 16 bytes each. One entry per unique hash (collisions merged at index time). MUST remain a separate mmap'd file; future combined files MUST start lookup at 64 KB-aligned offset for Windows MapViewOfFile compatibility
- **postings.bin:** Magic `PMPL` (4 bytes) + schema_version (u32) = 8 bytes header. Entries: bitmap_byte_length (u32) + serialized Roaring Bitmap bytes (portable serialization format pinned in index_meta.json as `roaring_format: "portable"`)

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/Tools.md, ContractName:Plans/Architecture_Invariants.md

**Implementation:** Resolve app data root at startup (env override optional). Create `storage/seglog`, `storage/redb`, `storage/jsonl`, `storage/tantivy` if missing. Use a single redb file for MVP; split by domain (e.g. `state.redb`, `rollups.redb`) only if needed later. Create `regex_index/` directories on first index build. On generation directory creation, set OS indexer exclusion attributes: Windows `FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NOT_CONTENT_INDEXED` via `SetFileAttributesW`, macOS `.metadata_never_index` file (Spotlight convention).

anchors.anchor: ### 2.4 Projector pipeline: consumption, JSONL mirror, Tantivy, checkpoints
anchors.content_markdown:
**Consumption model:** Each projector runs in a loop (or is triggered periodically):

1. Read **checkpoint** from redb (e.g. `projector.jsonl_mirror` → last seglog path + offset).
2. **Tail** seglog from that position (open file, seek to offset, read new lines; or list segments, read from last segment).
3. For each event: (a) write to JSONL mirror (if this projector owns the mirror), (b) update Tantivy index (if event type matches), (c) update redb snapshots if needed.
4. **Commit** new checkpoint to redb (and flush Tantivy) so we don't reprocess on restart.

**JSONL mirror:** Same envelope format as seglog; one file per day under `storage/jsonl/` (e.g. `events_2026-02-21.jsonl`) or one rolling file. Human-readable; useful for debugging and for analytics scan if we prefer scanning JSONL. Writer: single projector that reads seglog and appends to the mirror.

**Tantivy indices (required per project):** Indices are written under `storage/tantivy/projects/{project_id}/…` to enforce **project-only scoping** and keep performance stable for long-lived projects (Plans/assistant-chat-design.md §10.3). Separate index per domain:

- **chat (required):** Documents from `chat.message` (and optionally `chat.thread_created` / `chat.thread_updated`).
  **Fields (minimum):** `project_id`, `thread_id`, `message_id`, `role`, `ts`, `content`.
  **Optional fields:** `archived`, `deleted`, `context_overlay_flags` (muted/subcompacted markers) to support Context Lens filtering.
  **Use:** Chat history search (human + agent), and smart auto-retrieval (RAG) from prior project threads.

- **code (required, MVP):** A project-scoped code search index for the **project workspace / project root**.
  **Producer:** A file-watcher + indexer (can be implemented as a "projector" even though the source is filesystem change events rather than seglog). The indexer must respect `.gitignore` by default and apply FileSafe-style sensitive-path exclusions (see below).
  **Chunking:** Index large files as chunks so results return tight snippets (e.g. 4–16 KiB chunks with `chunk_id` and byte/line range metadata).
  **Fields (minimum):** `project_id`, `path`, `chunk_id`, `content`, `language?`, `mtime` (or `content_hash`).
  **Use:** `codesearch` tool and auto-retrieval for code grounding. LSP symbol search remains complementary (symbol-aware), not a replacement.

- **logs (required, MVP):** A project-scoped logs/search index based on **log summaries** with pointers to full payload.
  **Producers:** seglog projectors that consume `tool.invoked`, `tool.denied`, `run.*`, `bash.*`, and error events and emit index documents.
  **Index the summary, not the blob:** Store only compact summaries/snippets in Tantivy; store full (secrets-scrubbed) payload as a blob/file under `storage/blobs/…` referenced by `blob_ref` (or event id) so log search stays fast and storage remains bounded.
  **Fields (minimum):** `project_id`, `ts`, `thread_id?`, `run_id?`, `tool_name?`, `level?`, `summary`, `blob_ref` (or `event_id`).
  **Use:** `logsearch` tool, auto-retrieval for "why did this fail," and UI debugging surfaces.

- **docs (optional):** Index selected long-form docs or generated artifacts if needed for retrieval ("teach" mode, doc lookup). Prefer indexing doc summaries/pointers rather than full bodies when possible.

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/assistant-chat-design.md, ContractName:Plans/Tools.md, ContractName:Plans/FileSafe.md

**File watcher: dual-consumer model (Tantivy + sparse n-gram index):**

The project file watcher is a shared event source with two independent consumers:
1. **Tantivy code indexer** — receives file-change events, re-indexes affected chunks in the per-project Tantivy code index.
2. **Sparse n-gram indexer** — receives the same file-change events, adds changed paths to the dirty layer (HashMap with generation stamps). PM-mediated writes (agent/tool writes) update the dirty layer synchronously (before returning to caller) and do NOT rely on the file watcher for freshness. The file watcher serves as backup/dedup for PM-mediated writes and as the primary notification path for external changes (user edits in other tools, git operations).

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/Tools.md, ContractName:Plans/GitHub_Integration.md

File watcher overflow handling (applies to both consumers): When the OS emits an overflow/rescan event (inotify `IN_Q_OVERFLOW`, FSEvents "must scan", Windows RDCW buffer overflow): Tantivy triggers a full re-index of the code domain. Sparse n-gram indexer marks ALL indexed files as dirty (invalidating the dirty layer), which triggers the >1000-file re-anchor threshold immediately. Windows: use a generous watcher buffer size (64 KB) to reduce overflow frequency.

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/FinalGUISpec.md, ContractName:Plans/FileManager.md

**Sensitive indexing + persistence guards (chat + code + logs + regex n-grams):**
- **PolicyRule:no_secrets_in_storage / INV-002 (mandatory):** Any text persisted to seglog/redb/Tantivy/blob files/sparse n-gram index MUST be passed through a strict secrets scrubber that removes tokens/credentials/private keys. This mandatory scrub is always-on and not user-configurable. For the sparse n-gram index, scrubbing occurs before n-gram extraction — n-grams are extracted from scrubbed content.
- **Path-based exclusions (mandatory):** Default deny indexing of `.env` and `.env.*` while allowing `.env.example` (align with Permissions_System default `.env` deny semantics). Exclude common key/cert paths (e.g. `*.pem`, `*.key`, `id_rsa*`) from indexing and from log/blob persistence when detected.
- **Additional heuristic redaction (optional; default OFF):** `retrieval.redaction.secretish_enabled` MAY apply an additional aggressive heuristic redaction pass (on top of the mandatory scrub) to log-summary indexing, snippet display, and retrieved-context injection.

ContractRef: Invariant:INV-002, ContractName:Plans/Architecture_Invariants.md, ContractName:Plans/Permissions_System.md

**Blob refs (logs):**
- Store log payload blobs under `storage/blobs/projects/{project_id}/logs/` with a deterministic filename (e.g. `{event_id}.json` or `{content_hash}.json`).
- `blob_ref` is a stable identifier that resolves to this blob path; `logread` reads the blob and returns the secrets-scrubbed content (bounded by size caps).

**Schema per index:** Define fields (text, keyword, date) and build documents from event payloads / filesystem scanner output. Index is written incrementally (add/update documents) and periodically committed.

**Checkpoints:** Stored in redb under `checkpoints` namespace. Value encodes enough to resume: e.g. `{ "segment": "events_2026-02-21.ndjson", "offset": 123456 }` or `{ "seq": 99999 }`. On startup, projector reads checkpoint, opens seglog from that position, and continues. Code indexer maintains its own checkpoint (e.g. last scan watermark / file mtime map) and supports a full rebuild when schema changes. Sparse n-gram indexer maintains its own checkpoint via `index_meta.json` (anchor SHA, generation number) — rebuilt automatically on schema version mismatch.

- New remote queries or replace operations that need host round-trips must surface `stale`, `degraded`, or `unavailable` state explicitly instead of silently re-running locally.

A remote-mode project is a first-class project context bound to a remote host and remote path.

Remote-mode rules:
- file browsing, file mutation, git operations, terminal launches, Search execution, Source Control projections, LSP execution, and provider-side project tools all run against the remote host context
- remote-mode projects MUST NOT silently fall back to local checkout, local git, local shell, local Search, or local LSP execution
- UI surfaces may retain stale snapshots while disconnected, but they must label them accurately and block new host-required mutations when the remote context is unavailable
- **Search index acceleration exception:** The per-project sparse n-gram regex index is built and queried locally as an acceleration cache — this is not a "local fallback" because correctness is always verified against actual remote files (via SSH ripgrep on candidate files or via the local Git cache's `git show` piping). The acceleration cache narrows the candidate set; ripgrep verification ensures correctness against the authoritative remote content

**Remote project search index cache (Git-based projects):**

For remote Git projects, PM maintains a local cache to enable near-zero-SSH grep performance:

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md, ContractName:Plans/BinaryLocator_Spec.md, ContractName:Plans/Architecture_Invariants.md

1. **Local bare Git clone:** On project open, PM clones the remote repo as a bare Git clone to `.puppet-master/cache/r/{hash8}/git/`. Clone type depends on per-project settings (full/shallow/partial). Git auth uses SSH agent forwarding through PM's existing SSH connection. If the remote repo is only accessible from the remote host's network (corporate firewall), the clone is initiated on the remote host and streamed to local via `git bundle` over SSH. Fallback: if local bare clone fails for any auth/network reason, fall back to the non-Git remote path (remote-build, local-query, remote-verify).
2. **Submodule handling:** `--recurse-submodules` does not work with bare clones (no working tree). PM parses `.gitmodules` from the bare repo (with path traversal validation — reject paths containing `..`), then separately bare-clones each submodule repo into `.puppet-master/cache/r/{hash8}/git/m/{sub_hash8}/`. Recursive: submodule repos are also parsed for nested submodules (max depth: 5). Removed submodules treated as deleted; changed URLs replace old clone.
3. **Index build:** Runs locally against the local Git cache. Content read via `git cat-file --batch` (NOT filesystem walk — bare clone has no working tree). Same build pipeline as local projects (secrets scrub → CRLF-strip → ASCII-lowercase → n-gram extraction).
4. **Bare clone verification:** Ripgrep cannot search bare Git clones directly (no working tree). Verification of candidate files uses `git show {anchor_sha}:{path}` piped to ripgrep stdin per candidate file. This preserves zero-SSH without requiring a working tree checkout.
5. **Dirty layer:** File-change notifications arrive over SSH from the remote host. Files ≤1 MB: content included with notification, written to local staging area at `.puppet-master/cache/r/{hash8}/dirty/{relative_path}`. Immediately searchable. Files >1 MB: path recorded immediately, content fetched via background prefetch (not on-demand during grep). If grep runs before prefetch completes: block briefly (up to 5s), then SSH ripgrep for that single file.
6. **Git fetch cadence:** On project open (always), every 5 minutes after previous fetch+build cycle completes (timer, not configurable), on explicit user action. Each fetch that detects new commits: immediately compute `git diff --name-only old_anchor..new_HEAD` and add changed paths to dirty layer BEFORE incremental rebuild starts.
7. **Cache settings:** Two independent toggles per project (global default + per-project override, greyed out for local projects): shallow clone (OFF by default, `--depth=1`) and partial clone (OFF by default, `--filter=blob:none`). Can be combined. Disk usage indicator in project settings.
8. **Cache lifecycle:** Cache eviction: 30-day inactivity default, disk pressure limit (50 GB or 10% free disk, whichever smaller), manual per-project eviction. Cache NOT evicted on project close. On eviction: fresh clone + index build on next open.

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/FinalGUISpec.md, ContractName:Plans/Tools.md

**Remote project search index (non-Git projects):**

For non-Git remote projects, PM uses a remote-build/local-query/remote-verify architecture:

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/BinaryLocator_Spec.md, ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md

1. **Remote indexer binary:** PM ships a standalone indexer binary per target architecture (same core engine, stripped to build-only logic). Architecture detected via `uname -m` over SSH. Binaries shipped for x86_64 and aarch64. Binary scp'd to remote on first use, integrity-checked (xxh3 hash comparison after transfer). If no matching binary available: log warning, fall back to unindexed ripgrep over SSH.
2. **Remote build:** Indexer runs on the remote host over SSH, reading files locally on the remote. Indexer computes per-project frequency table during its full scan (same blending formula as local builds).
3. **Index transfer:** `postings.bin`, `lookup.bin`, `file_map.bin`, `frequency_table.bin`, `index_meta.json` transferred to local cache.
4. **Local query + remote verify:** Agent grep decomposes regex → queries local index → candidate paths → ripgrep only on candidate files over SSH.
5. **Incremental updates:** SSH file watcher marks paths dirty. Re-index triggers: dirty layer >1000 files OR 30-minute interval while project is open. If SSH file watcher unavailable (degraded), periodic full remote rebuild every 30 minutes.
6. **Cleanup:** Indexer binary (~5 MB) left on remote host for reuse. On PM project close or disconnect, offer optional cleanup. On PM uninstall: best-effort cleanup via SSH.
7. **Git repos without public remote URL:** Falls back to this non-Git path (same architecture).

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/Tools.md, ContractName:Plans/Architecture_Invariants.md

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/WorktreeGitImprovement.md, PolicyRule:Decision_Policy.md§2

- **Git operations:** run via SSH command on remote as specified in §C.3.

- **Grep (index-accelerated):** For remote projects with a local search index cache, grep queries the local index and verifies candidates against remote files (via local Git cache `git show` piping for Git projects, or SSH ripgrep for non-Git projects). The index narrows candidates; verification ensures correctness against authoritative remote content.
  ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/Tools.md, ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md
- Error — provider CLI not found on remote: show

To support both explicit agent reasoning and smart retrieval, provide agent-callable tools (or MCP equivalents) that query the project indices:

- `chatsearch(query, filters={thread_id?, time_range?}, k)` → hits with `thread_id`, `message_id`, `ts`, snippet, score.
- `codesearch(query, path?, mode={text|symbol}, k)` → hits with `path`, line/range, snippet (symbol-aware when LSP available).
- `logsearch(query, filters={time_range?, run_id?, thread_id?, tool_name?, level?}, k)` → hits with `event_id`/`blob_ref`, `ts`, short summary/snippet.
- `logread(ref)` → full payload (bounded by size caps; subject to stricter permission defaults).
- `grep(pattern, path?, glob?)` → index-accelerated regex search. When the per-project sparse n-gram index is available, grep transparently narrows candidate files before ripgrep verification — query latency <20ms regardless of repo size. Falls back to raw ripgrep when index is unavailable. Same tool interface, same limits (1000 matches, 30s timeout).

Search rules:
- Search commands are side-panel scoped and MUST preserve query-session state instead of acting like transient palette commands.
- remote queries and replaces use the effective remote host context; they MUST surface stale/degraded/unavailable state explicitly instead of silently falling back to local execution.
- When the regex toggle is active, find-in-files is accelerated by the per-project sparse n-gram index (same acceleration as agent `grep`). When the index is unavailable, Search falls back to raw ripgrep.

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/GitHub_Integration.md, ContractName:Plans/Wiring_Matrix.md, ContractName:Plans/LSPSupport.md

### SparseNgramIndex
The per-project sparse n-gram regex index that transparently accelerates `grep` tool calls and user-facing find-in-files regex search. Uses variable-length n-grams with frequency-weighted boundaries, Roaring Bitmap posting lists, xxh3 hashing, and generation-numbered directories published via ArcSwap for lock-free reads. The index narrows candidate files; ripgrep verifies for correctness. Built locally for all projects (including remote projects via local Git cache or remote-build transfer). Canonical definition in Plans/Tools.md §3.5.A and Plans/storage-plan.md §2.1.

ContractRef: Primitive:SparseNgramIndex, ContractName:Plans/Tools.md, ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md

### DirtyLayer
The in-memory path set (HashMap with generation stamps) tracking uncommitted file changes for the sparse n-gram regex index. PM-mediated writes update the dirty layer synchronously before returning to the caller, guaranteeing that agent writes are immediately searchable. External changes arrive via the file watcher. All dirty-layer paths are unconditionally included in grep candidate sets. Re-anchor clearing uses generation stamps to avoid race conditions with concurrent builds.

ContractRef: Primitive:SparseNgramIndex, ContractName:Plans/Tools.md, ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md

anchors.anchor: ## INV-002 -- No secrets in persistent storage
anchors.content_markdown:
**Rule:** Secrets (tokens, credentials, private keys) MUST NOT be written to:
- seglog event stream
- redb projections
- Tantivy indexes
- sparse n-gram regex index (n-grams are extracted from secrets-scrubbed content; file_map.bin stores project-scoped relative paths only)
- plaintext logs, evidence bundles, or state files

**Allowed persistence:** OS credential store only.

ContractRef: SchemaID:Spec_Lock.json#locked_decisions.storage, SchemaID:evidence.schema.json, PolicyRule:no_secrets_in_storage, ContractName:Plans/Tools.md, ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md

**Rule:** Providers and provider adapters MUST NOT write directly to persistent storage (seglog/redb/Tantivy/sparse n-gram index). They emit normalized events; storage writers/projectors own persistence.

ContractRef: Primitive:Provider, Primitive:SessionStore, ContractName:Plans/Crosswalk.md, ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md

### Remote indexer binary locator

For non-Git remote projects, PM ships a standalone sparse n-gram indexer binary per target architecture. The indexer binary is a stripped build-only variant of the core PM index engine, used to build the sparse n-gram index on the remote host where the project files reside.

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/GitHub_Integration.md, ContractName:Plans/Tools.md, ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md

**Shipped architectures:** x86_64 and aarch64 (covers >99% of development servers).

**Remote architecture detection:** Run `uname -m` over SSH before scp to determine the correct binary.

**Deployment rules:**
- On first use for a remote project, PM scp's the matching indexer binary to the remote host.
- After transfer, PM integrity-checks the binary via xxh3 hash comparison (local known hash vs remote `xxh3sum` or re-read).
- PM MUST NOT execute binaries received FROM the remote host — only sends its own pre-built binaries TO the remote.
- If no matching binary is available for the detected architecture: log a warning and fall back to unindexed ripgrep over SSH. Do not attempt cross-architecture execution.

ContractRef: Invariant:INV-002, ContractName:Plans/Architecture_Invariants.md

**Cleanup:**
- Indexer binary (~5 MB) is left on the remote host for reuse across sessions.
- On PM project close or disconnect: offer optional cleanup.
- On PM uninstall: best-effort cleanup via SSH.

**Index-accelerated grep analytics field:**

The `tool.invoked` seglog event for `grep` includes an optional `index_used: boolean` field. When `true`, the per-project sparse n-gram index was used to accelerate the query (narrowing candidates before ripgrep verification). When `false` or absent, raw ripgrep was used on all files (fallback path — index missing, building, corrupted, or disabled).

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/Tools.md, ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md, ContractName:Plans/Contracts_V0.md

This field enables analytics views to report:
- Percentage of grep calls that were index-accelerated vs fallback.
- Correlation between index availability and grep latency.
- Per-project index health (e.g., projects with frequent fallback may need index configuration tuning).

anchors.content_markdown:
### Search Index Acceleration Wiring Addendum

Cross-component wiring for the sparse n-gram regex index that transparently accelerates grep and Search panel regex.

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/Tools.md, ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md, ContractName:Plans/FinalGUISpec.md

**Grep tool ↔ Index Engine wiring:**

| Source | Target | Trigger | Data flow |
|---|---|---|---|
| Agent/subagent `grep` call | IndexEngine `query` | Tool invocation | pattern, path/glob filters → candidate file IDs |
| Search panel regex query | IndexEngine `query` | User executes find-in-files with regex ON | pattern, scope → candidate file IDs |
| IndexEngine candidates | ripgrep verification | Query returns candidate set | file IDs → paths → ripgrep on candidates → final matches |
| PM-mediated file write | DirtyLayer `insert` | Tool write returns | path → dirty layer (synchronous, before write returns to caller) |
| File watcher event | DirtyLayer `insert` | External file change detected | path → dirty layer (async, backup for PM-mediated writes) |

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/GitHub_Integration.md, ContractName:Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md

**Index build ↔ Storage wiring:**

| Source | Target | Trigger | Data flow |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project open | IndexBuilder `build_full` or `validate` | Project-ready signal (file watcher established) | project_id, HEAD SHA → index build or validation |
| Git fetch (remote) | IndexBuilder `build_incremental` | New commits detected | old_anchor..new_HEAD diff → changed files → incremental rebuild |
| `cmd.search.rebuild_regex_index` | IndexBuilder `build_full` | User action or command | project_id → full rebuild (delete + fresh build) |
| IndexBuilder completion | ArcSwap publish | New generation ready | new IndexSnapshot → atomic pointer swap |
| Status bar | IndexBuilder state | Build running >2s | build_state, progress % → "Indexing" indicator |

ContractRef: ContractName:Plans/FinalGUISpec.md, ContractName:Plans/storage-plan.md

### Instant Grep (sparse n-gram index) canon reconciliation note

The Instant Grep packet uses the following ownership split:
- `Tools.md` is the primary owner for grep tool semantics, index-accelerated query flow, covering algorithm, fallback behavior, and `tool.invoked` analytics fields

- `FinalGUISpec.md` is the primary owner for status bar Indexing indicator (§3.2), Indexing settings section (§7.4.2), and Search panel index-acceleration UX (Search side-panel owner)
- `GitHub_Integration.md` is the primary owner for remote project search index cache (§C.3), bare Git clone lifecycle, non-Git remote indexer binary, and cache settings
- `assistant-chat-design.md`, `UI_Command_Catalog.md`, `Glossary.md`, `Architecture_Invariants.md`, `BinaryLocator_Spec.md`, `usage-feature.md`, `Wiring_Matrix.md`, and `00-plans-index.md` are reconciliation consumers
